college.name: EIILM KOLKATA JALPAIGURI CAMPUS

location.address: Porapara Road, Pandapara Kalibari, Jalpaiguri, West Bengal - 735132

college.description: The Eastern Institute for Integrated Learning in Management (EIILM-Kolkata), Jalpaiguri Campus was established in 2018. EIILM-Kolkata (Jalpaiguri Campus) offers industry-focused undergraduate and postgraduate management and IT programs affiliated with state universities.

chairman.name: Prof. (Dr.) Rama Prosad Banerjee
chairman.background: An expert in Finance and Ethics and an international educationist who previously taught at IIM Calcutta.
chairman.focus: Combines modern business management with Indian spiritual values and Vedic civilization.

eiilm_kolkata.expansion: EIILM-Kolkata expanded its presence to North Bengal with a campus in Jalpaiguri.

jalpaiguri_campus.purpose: Brings management education to North Bengal.
jalpaiguri_campus.approach: Blends traditional ethics with professional corporate training.

ai.development_note: Coco is a collaborative group project. Bipasa Sen is the main developer responsible for designing and developing the complete application. Sombojit Chakraborty provided the initial idea for the AI chatbot and leads the junior group. The junior group is associated with the Research & Analysis Club. Other members contribute through roadmap design, information gathering, support, ideas, and encouragement.

bba_and_specializations.qualification: Passed 10+2 (Higher Secondary) in any general or vocational stream from a recognized board with English as a subject.

bca.qualification: Passed 10+2 in any stream from a recognized board with English as a compulsory subject.
bca.preferred_background: Mathematics, IT, or Computer Applications background is preferred.

mba_industry_integrated.qualification: Graduation in any discipline from a recognized university. Final-year students are also eligible to apply.
mba_industry_integrated.selection_criteria: Based on entrance examination/merit screening and personal interview.
